jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: revised original space-ark mechanical concept sheet.
Input image 1 is the edit target: preserve this ship's warm-white/navy/brick-red palette, long heavy inhabited hull, compact bridge, original bow character and stern propulsion, and the crisp mechanical art direction. The user now explicitly requires distinct mecha egress and recovery ports and different exploration/combat/mining onboard machines.
Make one clear revision of the middle third: replace the single giant generic opening with a substantial stepped side hangar shoulder containing TWO SEPARATE rectangular deep recessed ports, divided by thick hull structure. Forward port is a narrow launch lane with visible guide rails and a compact 20-meter humanoid mecha locked into an exit cradle; aft port is a taller recovery lane with an articulated capture frame, open inner buffer chamber and a small four-arm industrial machine being brought inside. Both mouths face sideways clear of stern exhaust, not a hole bored through the engine. Keep solid inhabited volumes above/below the ports. Introduce a controlled step in the upper midbody and strong bevels around the shoulders so the ship has a purposeful naval silhouette rather than one uniform cargo box. Do not convert the ship into a fighter, a monument or a station. No added weapons or giant wings.
Layout: 1536x1024 landscape. Upper two-thirds: complete revised ship in front-port three-quarter view on the same pale gray background; small and clean labels only "LAUNCH" and "RECOVERY", with fine leader lines to the respective visible doors. Lower third: ONE enlarged hangar cutaway inset belonging to the same revised ship, showing the TWO separated exterior doors, straight outgoing rail lane, separate incoming capture/buffer lane, and a shared rear maintenance gallery separated from outside by visible inner doors. Include tiny human service silhouettes and humanoid/industrial machines for scale. The inset is a concept arrangement, not a dimensioned blueprint; no numbers, measurements, pseudo-engineering text or complex labels. Distinguish ingress/egress with two simple arrows. Show readable door depth, wall thickness and fixed mechanical attachments. Neutral presentation and directional light, no stars or planets. This is a single coherent ark design, not multiple alternatives. Preserve the industrial Gundam-inspired mechanical language without copying a franchise vessel. Avoid fantasy architecture, floating cores, gold ornament, broad exposed gardens, generic shuttle as the only onboard machine.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: three-role onboard machine design sheet for the original human space ark GUIHANG, game Stellar Echoes.
Primary request: design THREE DISTINCT ORIGINAL shipborne machines, not three ordinary spaceships, using the disciplined Japanese anime hard-surface mechanical design language familiar from Mobile Suit Gundam. Shared navy/blue-gray structural frames, warm off-white armor and small brick-red identification panels; graphite joints; amber maintenance marks. High quality professional mecha design illustration, crisp intentional linework, carefully shaded volumes, plausible articulated parts, original silhouettes.
Layout: landscape 1536x1024 on clean very light cool-gray background. Three equally generous columns, one complete machine per column, front three-quarter views, no cropped extremities, soft contact shadows. Small plain labels above each exactly: "EXPLORATION", "COMBAT", "EXTRACTION". Give each object breathing room, not a crowded collage. These are a lineup of role silhouettes, not an exact orthographic scale chart.
Left EXPLORATION: compact non-humanoid reconnaissance working frame, short armored wedge torso around an inset panoramic sensor face, two articulated sensor/outrigger arms extended sideways with fine scanning antennae, two smaller underside manipulator/sample claws, small purposeful vector-thruster pods. No aircraft nose/wing silhouette, no long guns, no full human legs. Agile and perceptive, a machine for inspecting ruins and delicate sampling. Show a small foldable survey drone docked flush in its back, not a swarm.
Center COMBAT: a powerful approximately 20-meter class humanoid armored mobile frame. Solid torso, broad shoulders, compact single visor head WITHOUT Gundam V-fin or an existing franchise face, articulated arms and strong legs, backpack and calf maneuvering thrusters. One forearm-mounted angular protective shield; the opposite hand holds a short fictional conventional-looking space carbine lowered neutrally. No firing, blades, giant beam wings or energy halo. Heroic but restrained and utilitarian, protection and control rather than ornament, clear joints and replaceable armor.
Right EXTRACTION: non-humanoid heavy industrial machine with a low armored beetle-like body, two thick anchored clamp arms forward and two articulated tool arms each with a distinct cutter and rock gripper. Compact replaceable ore bin at rear visibly enclosed and attached, short stabilizing legs/grapples and industrial thrusters. Yellow/amber tool-head hazards distinguish dangerous working surfaces, not a new overall palette. Mechanical tool heads must have robust joints and anchors, no magic lasers or gemstone materials. No tank tracks required for free-space work.
All three have a visible common rectangular dorsal/ventral docking fixture, service access panels and compatible capture points for the ark's recovery cradle. Some used edges and replacement panels, not rusty wrecks. A small neutral human service silhouette near each base gives context. Keep the machines original; do not copy any named mobile suit, emblems or logos. No extra vehicles, planets, stars, elaborate scenery, UI, small unreadable paragraphs or engineering dimension claims.
